source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.pubescence: Dense spreading hairs on stems, dense soft hairs beneath leaflets
morphology_source_reported.leaves: Sessile or subsessile; leaflets (3–)4–8 cm long, 5–10 mm wide and 4–10 times longer than broad; prominent raised veinlets beneath
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Pale lavender to reddish purple or near-white, withering greenish
morphology_source_reported.diagnostic_characters: Narrow, subsessile leaves with strongly raised veinlets and densely hairy lower surfaces

habitat_source_reported: Sandy or rocky open woods, roadsides, fields
flowering_source_reported: Late May–Jul, less freely to Sep
cautions: Historical name and morphology require independent corroboration before identification scoring
